stances.summary: Highlights commitment to working class rights and dignity
stances.quote: I'm proud that the people of Central Florida continue to put their trust in me, and I don't take that for granted. Over the last term, we’ve fought for the rights and dignity of all people. Pushing to build power with and for the working class.

stances.summary: Notes running unopposed in upcoming election
stances.quote: For folks who may be confused: No one filed to challenge me in the election. So I have automatically won, unopposed.

stances.summary: Regrets lack of opposition, continues campaign efforts
stances.quote:
I would’ve much rather had an opponent. Voters always deserve a choice. It’s unfortunate that the Republican Party couldn’t get someone to run on their vision in FL10. 

I’m still running a big campaign. Knocking tens of thousands of doors and engaging with people.


Peter Schors

stances.quote:
I will run my biggest campaign operation since my first election.
Although I won't be on the ballot, we're focused on electing good people. We've already brought on 87 campaign Organizers this summer to help us flip seats across Central Florida and elect progressive champions.
